STATUS: fail SUMMARY: Most criteria held under 45 probes across all three components, including the extra cases you listed (Escape in a Combobox inside a Dialog, Enter in a form, duplicate Tabs ids, special-character ids, hidden-subtree focus, focus return across cycles). The one reproduced failure is in controlled Tabs: when the selected tab is disabled or removed, the component moves `aria-selected` to another tab without calling `onValueChange`, so the UI stops matching the `value` prop. The probe file is deleted and `git status` matches the start. FILES TOUCHED: none (probe file `src/zz_redteam_probe.test.tsx` created and deleted; `FEATURE_FLOW.md` does not exist in the repo, so nothing was touched there) FINDINGS: - [blocking] Controlled Tabs ignores `value` when the selected tab is disabled. `Tabs.tsx` `selected` falls back to `enabledValues[0]` with no callback. Reproduced with ``, then rerender with `Tab a disabled`: A has `aria-selected="false"`, B has `"true"`, `onValueChange` called 0 times. This breaks T2 ("value wins") and the checklist item "does not move on its own". - [minor] Controlled Tabs with the selected tab removed (`value="b"`, B removed) shows A selected with no callback. Same mechanism as above. Whether this should fall back is a design call; the criteria only specify fallback for `defaultValue`. - [minor] `Dialog` with `description=""` renders `aria-describedby` pointing to an empty `

`. README says the attribute is omitted only for `undefined`, `null` or `false`, so the code matches the README but a reader may expect `""` to be omitted. Not a criterion failure. - [minor] Backdrop closes on `click` alone; the spec says mousedown+click. Real-browser drag cases are handled by the browser (click targets the common ancestor), but `fireEvent.click` on the backdrop with no mousedown closes the dialog. Not reproduced in a browser. - [minor] `Combobox` "No results" is rendered as a sibling of the listbox, not inside it. Matches the README wording; flagging only as a spec-reading nit.
